0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Bhurborlor is running dangerously low on medicine for the injured.

24.original: Collect a pile of alpine seeds.

26.original: Collect a clump of mountain herbmoss.

27.original: Deliver the alpine seeds, urqobombyx larva, and mountain herbmoss to Bhurborlor.

48.original: You there, outsider! I have run dangerously low on ingredients for the concoction of essential medicine. Could I trouble you to go and fetch more?

49.original: While our size and strength is far greater than any visitor, there are no few of us that still fear injury and sickness.

50.original: I would send you to acquire three things: alpine seeds, an urqobombyx larva, and a good handful of mountain herbmoss. Fortunately, I believe they can all be harvested up the hill north of here.

51.original: Journey up the hill to the north and you should be able to find alpine seeds, mountain herbmoss, and at least one urqobombyx larva without much difficulty.

52.original: Did you have any trouble finding everything?

53.original: I am truly in your debt, outsider. Likewise, my kin will surely rest easy knowing the medicine supply has been replenished.

54.original: When Valigarmanda escaped its prison of ice, I confess I feared our doom to be imminent. But not only did you and yours swiftly end its rampage, the puissant healing magicks of your blue-clad companion saved a great many lives.

55.original: Rest assured, the ingredients you brought today will be put to good use preparing medicine for those still convalescing. Truly, our people cannot thank you enough!
